description:
My all time favourite Häagen Dazs flavour, Belgian Chocolate is on the cards today. What a stunning and yet really simple ice cream this is to make. 

Give this one a try and you will NOT be disappointed!

UPDATE: I found a small grater that made the chocolate perfect so try grating it in the mix if you can find a small enough utensil. 

Ingredients:
250ml Double Cream (Heavy Cream)
125ml Milk
125g Sugar (granulated or caster )
100g of 70% Belgian Chocolate
30g of Dark Cocoa Powder
30g Skimmed Milk Powder

UPDATE May 5th 2025:
I WILL BE MAKING THIS AGAIN IN A FEW DAYS SO STAY TUNED FOR AN UPDATED VERSION.


We'd love to see your creations so make sure to send us your photos!

Thanks again for watching and next video is....... Ben & Jerry's "Gimme S'more".


If you enjoyed this video, please consider liking and subscribing, plus pop over to our Instagram and Facebook pages linked below and say hello :)

Instagram: https://tinyurl.com/2p85zcxh
Facebook: http://tiny.cc/mmxosz
Website: https://polaricecreamery.com/


Thanks and see you on the next video :)

#haagendazs #icecream #icecreamrecipe #belgianchocolate #chocolateicecream #gelato

Why didn't you add corn syrup like your other icecream recipes?

comments.author: @meenakshisean

comments.text:
I make ice cream in different ways so people can use which method they prefer. 
Corn syrup is an invert sugar and helps depress the freezing point, dextrose does the same thing but you don’t NEED either in ice cream, it helps scoop but isn’t required. 
There are two theories around heating the cream, I haven’t decided which is “better” yet but again, you don’t need to. 
Rocky Road is a very different ice cream to this one. I’ve made a Rocky Road video so you might want to check that out as it goes through detail of what it is 👍
I will be doing lots of fruit based ice creams in the future so keep an eye out for those.
